title: Analysis code for the GOT experiment: exercise, exercise choice and coping with a nociceptive procedure in juvenile rainbow trout
description: R and Python code used to analyse the GOT experiment: trajectory processing of idtracker.ai tracking, identity matching, assignment of BORIS-scored aggression events, mixed models of behaviour, aggression, plasma and brain monoamines, robustness tests and the data figures of the article. See README.md for the map from article sections to scripts.
